column4: Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn from data.
Neural networks are computational models inspired by the human brain with layers of connected nodes.
Text classification assigns predefined categories to text using algorithms like SVM or BERT.
Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm that minimizes loss by updating weights iteratively.
The transformer architecture uses self-attention mechanisms to process sequences in parallel.
Learning to rank models optimize ranking metrics like NDCG using pairwise or listwise approaches.
Natural language processing enables computers to understand and generate human language.
Supervised learning uses labeled data while unsupervised learning finds hidden patterns without labels.
BERT is a bidirectional transformer pre-trained on masked language modeling and next sentence prediction.
Information retrieval is the process of finding relevant documents from a large collection given a query.
The weather today is sunny with a high of 75 degrees Fahrenheit in the afternoon.
Cooking pasta requires boiling water and adding salt before putting in the noodles.
Football is a sport played between two teams of eleven players on a rectangular field.
The stock market saw gains today as tech stocks rose following positive earnings reports.
A recipe for chocolate cake includes flour, cocoa powder, eggs, butter, and sugar.
Deep learning uses multiple layers of neural networks to learn hierarchical representations.
Random forests combine multiple decision trees to improve prediction accuracy and reduce overfitting.
Support vector machines find the optimal hyperplane that separates classes with maximum margin.
Word embeddings represent words as dense vectors capturing semantic relationships between terms.
Backpropagation computes gradients by applying the chain rule through the network layers.
